law.catch_line: Unlawful acts; prosecution; proceedings in equity

text.section: In addition to the provisions of subsection A of this section, the Department may institute proceedings in equity to enjoin any person from engaging in any unlawful act enumerated in this section. Such proceedings shall be brought in the name of the Commonwealth in the circuit court of the city or county in which the unlawful act occurred or in which the defendant resides.
Any person who willfully engages in any unlawful act enumerated in this section shall be guilty of a Class 1 misdemeanor.
